item.title: 🔴 World's Largest AI Model Repository Hugging Face Breached by Autonomous AI Agent
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

item.title: 🔴 SleeperGem Uses Three Malicious RubyGems Packages to Target Developer Machines
item.description:
Why this matters: Supply chain risk — audit third-party dependencies and vendor access.
Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a new software supply chain attack codenamed SleeperGem targeting the Ruby ecosystem after three malicious gems were published to RubyGems with the end goal of serving additional payloads. item.title: 🟠 Critical NGINX Vulnerability Can Crash Workers and May Allow Remote Code Execution
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
F5 has shipped fixes for a critical nginx flaw that lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker trigger a heap buffer overflow in the worker process with crafted HTTP requests. CVE-2026-42533 was patched on July 15 in nginx 1.30.4 (stable) and 1.31.3 (mainline), and in NGINX Plus 37.0.3.1; anyone on an earlier build should upgrade.
